mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.user_id, w.name, w.description, w.create_time, w.update_time, n.id as node_id, n.plugin_id as node_plugin_id, n.method_class_id as node_method_class_id, n.method_id as node_method_id, n.in_degree, dm.id as data_map_id, dm.node_id as data_map_node_id, dm.source_node_id, dm.source, dm.target, dm.source_type, dm.target_type, np.pre_node_id, nn.next_node_id, nd.id as node_defaults_id, nd.node_id as node_defaults_node_id, nd.param_index, nd.default_value, nd.default_value_type, p.id as plugin_id, p.name as plugin_name, p.description as plugin_description, p.version as plugin_version, mc.id as method_class_id, mc.class_name as method_class_name, mc.simple_class_name as method_class_simple_name, m.id as method_id, m.name as method_name, m.return_type as method_return_type, c.id as condition_id, c.workflow_id as condition_workflow_id, c.node_id as condition_node_id, c.field_name, c.preset_content, c.content_type, c.action, c.else_action, c.operator FROM workflow_info w LEFT JOIN node n ON w.id = n.id LEFT JOIN data_map dm ON n.id = dm.node_id LEFT JOIN node_pre_relation np ON n.id = np.node_id LEFT JOIN node_next_relation nn ON n.id = nn.node_id LEFT JOIN node_defaults nd ON n.id = nd.node_id LEFT JOIN plugin_info p ON n.plugin_id = p.id LEFT JOIN method_class_info mc ON n.method_class_id = mc.id LEFT JOIN method_info m ON n.method_id = m.id LEFT JOIN `condition` c ON w.id = c.workflow_id WHERE w.id = #{id}
